title: Each named discrete scalar seed has a unique global fixed-shape small-coupling optimizer branch

inputs.seed_scope: symmetric Rademacher and the K1688 sixth-cumulant-canceling three-point seed

optimizer.coercivity_reason: For either discrete non-Gaussian seed j_X(q)>0 away from zero and j_X(q) diverges as q approaches u because discrete-channel MMSE decays while gamma diverges.

scope_guard: Global means the one-dimensional objective for one fixed shape and one named discrete seed at sufficiently small g; it does not cover moving shapes, every bounded seed or finite-strength optimization.
